hero.caption: Photochrome postcard of the elegant Marlborough-Blenheim Hotel, Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, built in 1913. Published by The Post Card Distributing Co., Atlantic City, New Jersey. The back is divided and bears a cancelled one-cent stamp of George Washington.
